label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter flows directly into printf via the %s placeholder. The substring operation removes only the last character, which does not sanitize special characters like '%', allowing format string attacks.

evidence.note: Parameter read from request, passed to doSomething which truncates only the last char, then used in printf with %s allowing format specifiers.
printf uses tainted variable bar with format specifier %s, vulnerable to format string attack.
